NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Non-Disclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of March 3, 2024, between:

DISCLOSING PARTY: Quantum Dynamics Inc., a Nevada corporation
RECEIVING PARTY: Stellar Advisors LLC, a New York limited liability company

The parties wish to explore a potential business relationship. In connection therewith, Disclosing Party may disclose certain confidential information to Receiving Party.

1. Definition of Confidential Information. "Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by Disclosing Party to Receiving Party, either directly or indirectly, in writing, orally or by inspection of tangible objects.

2. Obligations. Receiving Party shall hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall not disclose any Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of Disclosing Party.

3. Term. The obligations under this Agreement shall survive for a period of five (5) years from the date of disclosure of the applicable Confidential Information.

4. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.

Signed:

/s/ Alan Turing
Alan Turing
Chief Scientific Officer, Quantum Dynamics Inc.

/s/ Grace Hopper
Grace Hopper
Managing Partner, Stellar Advisors LLC
